items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Tito Puente came with us and played about one year and a half or two years.

ctx.x: ......and he was good, so we had an idea, I had an idea the way he played so one day Sacasas want to organize his band and Mario recommend Tito Puente to Sacasas so rather they went to Ben Matthews' Riviera, he went to Chicago with Tito Puente. When they come back, I don't what happened that he quit and Tito Puente came with us and played about one year and a half or two years.
